title: Dabl Bot
tagline: An AI-assisted developer onboarding platform with a chatbot and playground.
description: We have a web widget featuring a robust search engine for smart contracts, a remix-based playground, and a chatgpt-based chatbot. I successfully minted a token using this platform, demonstrating its user-friendly interface and seamless functionality. This token highlighted the platform's capabilities and ease of use in the blockchain space.
how_its_made: We use ChatGPT as the back end of the chatbot and a clone of Remix for development. The contract was minted in this clone. It is an ERC-20 token with a fixed supply, ensuring consistency, security, and long-term stability in its value. We use ChatGPT as the back end of the chatbot and a clone of Remix for development. The contract was minted in this clone.
